race.comment: Tricky race. GENESIS RUNNER (9) returned in good shape when he stalked the pace for a closing second over 1300m in the G3 Up and Coming Stakes at this track. Well placed again and will keep finding on the limit. TENENBAUM (5) progressive colt held in high regard by the stable. Lugged the 61kg first up for an authoritative win over 1200m at Canterbury. Drops 7kg today and ticks plenty of boxes at the each way price. HIDRIX (3) Group 3 winner on debut last January and looks to have strengthened over the break. Took on the older horses first up with a respectable fifth over 1200m at Randwick in BM78 class. Value player ready for the extra ground. STORMY MARCO (2) won the Clarendon on debut, then should have finished much closer when third in the G1 J J Atkins over 1600m at Eagle Farm last June. Back with the one trial and will be strong late. PERSIAN WONDER (7) comes here with a massive fitness edge fourth up. Proven at this trip and no shock to see him win.
